purpose: Raw-only opt-in receiver inter-frequency code-bias states for secondary GPS L5 and Galileo E5a pseudorange factors. The Phase10 PR/D/TDCP/IMU graph and all production defaults remain unchanged.

truth_free_selection.interpretation: Raw paired-code separations are stable at approximately 160 m. The candidate therefore models a static secondary receiver-code bias rather than forming an uncorrected ionosphere-free combination, which would amplify this separation.

algorithm_contract.base_recipe: Phase10 native raw PDC+IMU+ordinary TDCP graph, unchanged
algorithm_contract.secondary_observation_gate: use_multi_frequency_double_difference=true only for this opt-in candidate so the existing common eligibility choke point admits raw secondary observations; no DD factors or IFLC combination are enabled
algorithm_contract.signal_bias_states: one static meter-valued receiver bias per eligible (system, secondary signal), relative to the primary signal; GPS L5 and Galileo E5a are eligible on this route
algorithm_contract.factor_model: range + c*(epoch clock + constellation ISB) + signal bias - corrected pseudorange
algorithm_contract.bias_sign: positive state increases predicted secondary-code range; the observed primary-minus-secondary raw separation therefore initializes toward a negative secondary bias
algorithm_contract.bias_prior: zero-mean weak gauge prior with sigma 1000 m; fixed before any truth read, not a truth-trained correction
algorithm_contract.pair_handling: No observations are dropped or combined. Primary and unpaired observations retain the ordinary factors; eligible secondary factors receive their signal state.
algorithm_contract.ionosphere: Existing per-signal Klobuchar correction remains unchanged; this candidate does not claim first-order IFLC and adds no second TGD correction.
algorithm_contract.tdcp_arcs: Existing signal-specific (satellite, signal) ADR arcs and Phase10 gates remain unchanged; secondary arcs admitted by the same opt-in eligibility gate are counted explicitly.
algorithm_contract.fallback: The candidate is opt-in; disabled mode must be byte-equivalent to Phase10. Nonfinite or unsupported signal-bias state construction fails closed.
algorithm_contract.promotion_gate: After truth-free artifact seal, WGS84 linear must be < 3.913768483524376 m and all four existing diagnostic variants must be non-regressive; otherwise No-Go. A passing development route does not authorize validation, holdout, or submission.

evaluation_protocol.truth_read: none before this freeze record and its separately hashed manifest

freeze_record_hash: computed after apply_patch and recorded in the companion manifest
